summary: Teradata Corp. filed an 8-K to report entry into a $400 million unsecured revolving credit facility with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent, replacing a prior 2022 credit agreement. The facility matures on June 24, 2031, with an optional $200 million accordion feature and up to $100 million in foreign currency borrowings. The term loan under the prior agreement was repaid in full. Interest rates are floating based on leverage-adjusted margins. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special-category event is involved.
